function.description: Place an order for food delivery on Uber Eats by specifying the restaurant and the items with their respective quantities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

restaurant.description: The name of the restaurant from which to order food.

items.description: A list of food item names selected for the order.

message.content: I’m sorry—I don’t have access to airline systems to look up your flight status. However, I can certainly help you place an Uber Eats order! If you’d like me to do that instead, just let me know the restaurant and the items (and how many) you’re craving.
message.reasoning:
The user wants flight status. We have no tool for that; we can respond politely asking if they want anything else or maybe place an Uber Eats order? But not relevant.

We should ask clarifying question about what they'd like us to do next. Possibly offer help ordering food via Uber Eats. So answer accordingly.
